title: Task
description: A single task in the Mongolian Spelling & Dictation task bank (Task table in DB)

id.description: Human-readable ID. Format: G12-NNN (Grades 1–2) or G24-NNN (Grades 2–4). Versions: G12-001v2.

task_type.description: Task type. Determines the required shape of the 'options' field. See $defs for each options shape and the allOf section for which types use which shape.

correct_answer.description: Canonical correct answer string. Semicolons for multi-part answers (dictation). 'PLACEHOLDER' for unfinished tasks.

options.description: JSONB payload — shape depends on task_type. See $defs below. Empty object {} is valid for placeholder tasks only.

oneOf.description: Empty object — only for placeholder/unfinished tasks

audio_url.description: URL to dictation audio asset (null until asset pipeline produces it)

image_url.description: URL to image asset for TT_IMAGE_WORD_MATCH and visual tasks (null otherwise)

error_targets.description: MVP error codes this task addresses: B1, B3, C1, C2, C4, D3, E1, E2, E7, G1, G2, H4. Use 'Mixed' for checkpoint tasks.

grade_band.description: Target grade(s): G1=Grade 1, G2=Grade 2, G3=Grade 3, G4=Grade 4

lesson_slot_fit.description: Where in a lesson session this task fits best

feedback_text.description: Short corrective feedback shown after an incorrect attempt (Mongolian)

feedback_correct.description: Positive feedback shown after a correct attempt (Mongolian)

feedback_wrong.description: Additional feedback shown after a wrong attempt (Mongolian)

is_diagnostic.description: true = this task is part of the diagnostic pool

SkillCode.description: S1=Үсэг-авиа ялгалт, S2=Үгийн зөв бичлэг, S3=Урт/богино эгшиг, S4=Балархай эгшиг, S5=Залгавар/нөхцөл, S6=Өгүүлбэрийн тэмдэглэгээ, S7=Сонсголоор буулгах, S8=Алдаа засах

ChoiceOptions.title: ChoiceOptions
ChoiceOptions.description:
Multiple-choice tasks: learner selects the correct word/spelling from 2–4 options.
Used by: TT_LISTEN_CHOOSE, TT_IMAGE_WORD_MATCH, TT_CHOOSE_CORRECT, TT_SIMPLE_SUFFIX, TT_WORD_FORM_CHOOSE, TT_SUFFIX_CHOOSE, TT_CONSONANT_CONFUSION, TT_LONG_VOWEL_CHALLENGE, TT_CASE_SUFFIX, TT_MIXED_REVIEW, TT_MIXED_WORD_SET, TT_MIXED_CHECKPOINT

choices.description: Exactly one item must have is_correct: true

audio_trigger.description: true = play audio automatically on load (TT_LISTEN_CHOOSE). false = visual-only choice.

FillOptions.title: FillOptions
FillOptions.description:
Single-blank fill-in-the-word tasks: learner types the missing character(s).
Used by: TT_LETTER_FILL, TT_FILL_WRITE, TT_MISSING_LETTER, TT_WORD_ENDING, TT_LONG_VOWEL_FILL, TT_REDUCED_VOWEL, TT_SUFFIX_WRITE, TT_COMPOUND_SUFFIX

display_text.description: Word with underscore(s) marking the blank, e.g. 'н_м', 'бөмб_г'

blank_position.description: 0-based character index of the blank in the full word

blank_answer.description: The correct character(s) to fill the blank, e.g. 'о', 'ө', 'тэр'

context_word.description: Full correct word without blanks (used for hints and answer-checking), e.g. 'ном'

SentenceFillOptions.title: SentenceFillOptions
SentenceFillOptions.description:
Sentence-level blank fill tasks: learner types the missing word or vowel within a sentence.
Used by: TT_SENTENCE_FILL, TT_LONG_VOWEL_IN_SENTENCE, TT_REDUCED_VOWEL_IN_SENTENCE

sentence_template.description: Sentence with underscores marking the blank(s), e.g. 'Энэ бол _____.' or 'Н_р мандлаа.'

blank_answer.description: The correct answer to fill the blank — a word, suffix, or vowel character(s)

context_sentence.description: Full correct sentence without blanks (used for answer-checking), e.g. 'Энэ бол ном.' or 'Нар мандлаа.'

hint.description: Optional hint shown after a wrong attempt (Mongolian)

CorrectionOptions.title: CorrectionOptions
CorrectionOptions.description:
Error identification and correction tasks: learner finds and fixes a spelling/punctuation error.
Used by: TT_COPY_WRITE, TT_CAPITAL_PUNCTUATION, TT_FIND_ERROR, TT_FIX_ERROR, TT_WORD_FORM_FIX, TT_FIND_OMITTED_LETTER, TT_SENTENCE_BOUNDARY, TT_BASIC_COMMA, TT_EXPLAINED_CORRECTION

incorrect_text.description: Text containing the error(s) shown to the learner, e.g. 'номм', 'би явна'

correct_text.description: The fully corrected target text, e.g. 'ном', 'Би явна.'

error_type.description: Primary MVP error code embedded in this task, e.g. 'G1', 'C1', 'H4'

hint.description: Hint shown after a wrong attempt (Mongolian), e.g. 'Эхний үсэг том, төгсгөлд цэг.'

explanation.description: Optional: rule explanation for TT_EXPLAINED_CORRECTION (why the correction is needed)

DictationOptions.title: DictationOptions
DictationOptions.description:
Audio dictation tasks: learner transcribes spoken words or sentences.
Used by: TT_WORD_SET_DICTATION, TT_TWO_WORD_DICTATION, TT_SHORT_SENTENCE_DICTATION, TT_TWO_SENTENCE_DICTATION

audio_text.description: Comma-separated text that will be read aloud, e.g. 'ном, гэр, нар' or 'Нар мандлаа.'

word_count.description: Number of words / tokens in the dictation

expected_answers.description: Ordered list of correct tokens, e.g. ['ном', 'гэр', 'нар']

allow_partial.description: true = award partial credit for each correctly transcribed token

MiniTextOptions.title: MiniTextOptions
MiniTextOptions.description:
Short passage dictation: learner transcribes a 2–3 sentence passage.
Used by: TT_MINI_TEXT_DICTATION

audio_text.description: Full passage text to be read aloud

sentence_count.description: Number of sentences in the passage (typically 2–3)

expected_answers.description: List of correct sentences in order

SelfCheckOptions.title: SelfCheckOptions
SelfCheckOptions.description:
Self-evaluation tasks: learner compares their earlier attempt to the model answer.
Used by: TT_SELF_CHECK, TT_OWN_WRITING_CORRECTION

original_attempt.description: The learner's previous (possibly incorrect) answer, e.g. 'сү'

model_answer.description: The correct model answer shown for comparison, e.g. 'сүү'

comparison_mode.description: How the UI presents the comparison: side_by_side = two columns; highlight_diff = inline diff highlighting
